name: pulse
description: A band above the prompt: what Claude is doing while it works, and the context, prompt cache, last turn and git at a glance while it waits, unfolding into a card with tabs. Draws shell commands as compact rows.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: while-active: the band's spinner and the Bash rows' turn while Claude works, and a new action fades in. off: everything stands still (the time and the cache countdown still count). Claude Code's Reduce motion setting stills it too.

band.title: Band
band.description: on: the band above the prompt shows at all times, folded to one row until you unfold it. off: it is hidden; /pulse band on shows it for the session.

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: auto and plain: the band draws Unicode glyphs and a rounded card. text: ASCII stand-ins (v for a tick, x for a failure, = and - for meters) and a classic border, for terminals whose font lacks the glyphs.
